notes: This metadata-only release promotes the deployed v1.2.0-rc.6 application and firmware payload unchanged to final stable v1.2.0.
Updates release discovery metadata to prepare the support-guided v1.3.0-rc.1 pointer and later v1.3.0 release candidates.
Keeps normal online updates on the stable release channel by default while preserving the support-guided release-candidate toggle.
Keeps application behavior, the bundled firmware binary, device protocol, motion, pressure control, Model behavior, and updater logic identical to v1.2.0-rc.6.
Machines already running v1.2.0-rc.6 do not require another firmware flash.

requires_firmware.note: Uses the same bundled firmware artifact as v1.2.0-rc.6; machines already running that release candidate do not require another firmware flash.

summary: Final stable promotion of the deployed v1.2.0-rc.6 payload.
validation: Get-ChildItem releases\*.json | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }
